title: Retain the qubit periodic and broader target-specific fixed-word hypotheses
statement: One reviewed theorem uses a deterministic periodic qubit bath against fixed zero-area words with frozen identity through degree4 and fresh independent whole-word even signs; it retains Hamiltonian terms and quartic covariance to prove accumulated pair-distinguishability loss, not a sum of local infidelities. A separate target-specificZ1recurrence needs only vanishing frozen first/second coefficients, nonzeroAusage and fresh even signs, and extends to predetermined finite clean/higher-order macro concatenations with fixed nonzero intended angles. It does not cover word shape/degree/macro count growing with accuracy. At d=1/1000,N=24543692606171 the supplied92segmentexample has moving-bath error>0.9999778781 but zero-bath diamond error<0.00001466109, with2258019719767732segments and2Nfreshbits. The other92segmentdegree5certificate atd=1e-9 gives error>0.9964 under its own hypotheses. These do not establish an all-native constant floor.
